### Devotional: Ezra 2
Author: D. A. Carson
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/devotionals/read-the-bible/genesis-2-matthew-2-ezra-2-acts-2/
Passage: Ezra 2:1-70
Points:
- The detailed recording of names, families, and animals highlights that God values factual precision and truth rather than vague emotionalism.
- Such meticulous reporting provides eyewitness authority and historical authenticity to the biblical record of the return.
- Listing these specific exiles confers divine honor on those who willingly abandoned comfort in Babylon to rebuild Jerusalem.
- Excluding unverified families from the priesthood demonstrated the community's serious commitment to covenant purity and divine instruction.
- The returnees' sacrificial giving toward the house of the Lord stands as an enduring model of devotion despite their subsequent human failures.
